sessions.phase_label: Meta advertising-access troubleshooting and alternate-account planning

requirements.title: Restore Existing Meta Advertising Access
requirements.definition: Restore the client's ability to run Meta advertisements through the existing personal profile and associated advertising account despite the profile-level integrity restriction.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the outcome of restoring advertising access on the existing profile and ad account. Identity verification, support tickets, 2FA toggling, screen sharing, and other troubleshooting methods are evidence or implementation steps rather than independent Requirements.

requirements.title: Set Up Alternate Meta Account Access
requirements.definition: Configure the cousin's Meta account as an alternate account through which the client can access and run advertisements.
requirements.boundary_note: Identity documents, initial cousin participation, 2FA codes, and adding another login email are attributes or steps of one alternate-account setup mechanism. Ongoing campaign management is independently actionable and remains separate.

requirements.title: Manage Facebook Advertising Campaigns
requirements.definition: Manage the client's Facebook advertising campaigns after suitable account access has been established, without requiring the cousin's ongoing participation.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers campaign operation after access is available. It excludes restoration or provisioning of the underlying account and excludes scheduling, contract closure, and payment administration.
